item.content:encoded: Editor’s note: Want to keep up with the latest from Google Cloud? Check back here for a monthly recap of our latest updates, announcements, resources, events, learning opportunities, and more.This month, we focused on making AI highly practical for your business, including its associated costs. item.content:encoded: BigQueryFeatureYou can now create, store, andmanage pipelines in Git folders.This feature is inPreview.FeatureBigQuery now supports TabFM,Google's pre-trained foundation model for tabular data.
